cells.gaps: No total of local registration offices is given, so both counts are floors: 30 SMS-supported stations in three districts (LSO-002, 2026) and 15 enrolment centres online to the central server (LSO-023, 2022), which are different systems and are not reconciled. How the SMS platform's record is made and where it is held is not stated, LSO-014 does not name the register, and LSO-022 says the centres allow for birth registration without saying the entry is made there; nationwide scale-up is an action for 2026-2027 and deaths are not shown entered at any local office.
cells.note: Digital birth registration is live past its pilot in a counted set of local offices, which meets stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half of offices on a share or a count with a denominator, and no denominator is published.
